name: Field Notes
concept: An open archival field book gives reasons 01–03 and 04–06 two related pages with a visible binding, page tabs, and an active reading marker.
silhouette: a two-page editorial book, not a row index; the pages stack in DOM order on phones
interaction: Pointer, touch, or keyboard focus moves the current-note marker without hiding or rewriting any reason. The first note is selected without JavaScript.
safety: The book is a specimen, not a client record. ₹4.2L and Reply under 2m retain adjacent illustrative qualifications.
